videos.script: Last night somebody changed edge1 by hand. Nobody said anything. {{change}} How would you find out? And when it happened? {{question}} A backup that keeps one copy cannot tell you. A backup that keeps a history can. {{history}} In this lesson a script reads every router's running configuration at once. It stores them in a Git repository. It commits only when something changed, so each commit is a change with a date. {{git}} It also says, loudly, when a router did not answer. Otherwise an old file looks exactly like a new one. {{failed}} Then you compare the backup with what the data says should be running. You see what is missing and what is extra, section by section. {{compare}} And you put the old configuration back, from the history. {{restore}}
